title: Publish the project
details: The repository is public at github.com/codesweep-ai/npmrevs, and main is pushed. The five ghcr.io packages are public already: ghcr.io gives a package the visibility of the repository its source label names. What remains, in order. Set Settings > Pages > Source to GitHub Actions: pages.yml fails on every run until it is. Publish the five packages once by hand, with npm/publish.sh from a machine logged in to npm, because npm names a trusted publisher only for a package that exists. Name npm.yml as the trusted publisher of each of the five, and set each package to require two-factor authentication and disallow tokens. Add the project to the CI dashboard. Tag v0.1.0, publish the draft release goreleaser leaves behind, and run make npm-publish so the release takes the latest tag: the npm workflow publishes dev builds only. The move-to-npmrevs branches of lint, ledger and ui can merge once the module resolves from GitHub.
